run_identity_decision.rationale: Attempt 4 received an independent go and created H200 lineage 465183→465186 under template=axolotl with live CPython 3.11.10. After axolotl attestation, env/tests, and the in-run candidate-v2 reference evaluation (590/725 exact), the first challenger aborted because jl run created uv venv --system-site-packages and Transformers imported the axolotl image flash_attn_2_cuda ABI-mismatched against venv torch 2.13.0. The immutable run directory retains the spent go, infrastructure-failure receipt, reference evidence, pause proof, and lifecycle. This attempt-5 successor corrects only the venv-isolation / flash_attn fail-closed contract and protected denylist; scientific bindings remain those attempt-3/4 audits accepted. The 590/725 reference score is attempt-4 evidence only and must never become an unauthenticated CLI float.

hypothesis: The candidate-v2 (35M, 602/756) versus Qwen2.5-0.5B (663/756) gap cannot currently be attributed to parameter count versus pretraining-token budget. A matched-adaptation sweep over pinned base checkpoints (pythia-70m-deduped ~3e11 tokens; SmolLM2-135M ~2e12; SmolLM2-360M ~4e12) on the identical frozen Mobile Actions SFT recipe, scored on a fresh grouped selection split, separates the axes.
decision: Which base-model scale, and which axis (tokens versus parameters), the project adopts for the next post-training phase: the smallest configuration clearing a +3.0-point exact-match margin over the in-run candidate-v2 reference on the fresh selection split with schema validity >= 0.95 and zero truncations, missing predictions, and generation failures; otherwise explicit per-axis falsification.

attempt_5_corrections.INFRA-1: freeze project venv isolation with include-system-site-packages=false. JarvisLabs jl run hardcodes uv venv --system-site-packages on the axolotl image, which exposed image flash_attn_2_cuda into Transformers on attempt-4. Launch packaging must recreate the project .venv without --system-site-packages after the provider's initial creation (safe_run --isolated-project-venv) and reinstall the frozen requirements, which pin torch==2.13.0 so CUDA torch is present without system-site inheritance.
attempt_5_corrections.INFRA-2: runner enforce_venv_isolation fail-closes before Torch/CUDA import and before any challenger AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained: active VIRTUAL_ENV pyvenv.cfg must read include-system-site-packages = false exactly, and import flash_attn must raise ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError. A CPU-hermetic unit test synthesizes contaminated and isolated pyvenv.cfg cases and would have rejected attempt-4.

isolation_approach_chosen.name: isolated_project_venv_without_system_site_packages
isolation_approach_chosen.why: Preferred over a flash_attn stub or uninstall-only shadow because a durable pyvenv.cfg include-system-site-packages=false check is least forgeable, matches the temporal-lane torch==2.13.0 pin pattern, and removes the entire system-site ABI surface (not only flash_attn) from the Transformers import path. The runner independently re-checks the live pyvenv.cfg and that import flash_attn fails before any model work.
